characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.description: Gjertrud is a middle-aged woman with a robust build, typical of someone who has spent her life engaged in manual labor such as baking. She has a red hat prominently worn on her head, signifying a splash of color in her otherwise traditional attire. Her facial features show signs of weathering and experience, with expressive eyes that shift from curiosity to frustration. At first, she is seen in a dimly lit, rustic kitchen environment with tools and implements for baking surrounding her. Her clothing consists of a simple dress that suggests modesty and practicality. Over the course of events, her demeanor shifts from hospitable, to surprised, to frustrated as her efforts to bake smaller lefses continually fail. Eventually, her transformation into a bird is marked by a distinctly red crest on her head, retaining the hint of her original hat, and her body turns entirely black, sullied by soot from the chimney.

characters.name: Gjertrudsfuglen
characters.description: Gjertrudsfuglen, once Gjertrud, is now a bird characterized by her distinctly red crest, reminiscent of her former hat. Her entire body is blackened, as if stained by soot, signifying her past life and transformation. She is depicted pecking persistently at tree trunks, amidst a backdrop of a forest, searching for sustenance in a perpetual cycle of hunger and thirst. Her existence is marked by an eternal quest for food and her wait for rain to quench her thirst, wandering in a natural setting where raindrops occasionally fall, symbolizing her cursed life. Her form is small and agile, with a sense of urgency and longing in her movements.
